analysis.processing_rate_note: No source-counter reset was observed. This processing rate uses the first and last runtime samples; the sampling interval is recorded separately from the formal event window.

gpu.note: GPU CSV collected by the CPU helper via existing Savant containers. Sample-observed timestamps are kept separately from the original nvidia-smi timestamp; no system clocks were changed.

unverified_uuid_check.note: Original quality failure states are retained. Frame UUID/timeline checks diagnose guard discrepancies; they do not assert frame-accurate centering of every video.

note: Source-isolated follow-up using one upstream H264 RTSP session shared locally to 60 independent source adapters. Business parameters remain unchanged; movie offsets differ. Reader isolation and GPU telemetry are verified separately. Event coverage is not established by saved-video timing alone. Original event/evidence timestamps are preserved.

all_video_decode.method: FFmpeg software decode of every frame with -xerror, 2 codec threads, four files concurrently; performed after the formal load. This does not verify event coverage or centering.

forwarder_budget.note: Admissions are a lower bound because queue-full rejection/eviction has no separate counter. In-flight sends may cause small endpoint differences. Frame-equivalent seconds are not measured detection outages.

scheduler_stage_summary.note: Formal log window is filtered by completion log time (UTC log prefix), not original event time; distinguish from per-event acceptance statistics. all_captured also includes prefill/postfill/drain.

validation_scope: Media-worker P0/P1 fixes; no CPU, model interval, analysis budget, or remux concurrency change during formal sampling.
